title: Move docs sites (Kanbus mkdocs, Tactus, Biblicus, Cyclotron docs) to Papyrus Markus publications
description: Kanbus uses mkdocs; Tactus, Biblicus and Cyclotron keep docs/ trees. Decide one docs pattern (a docs-flavored Markus publication with sidebar nav) then convert each. Needs Markus directive coverage for admonitions, code tabs and API reference first.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Status 2026-10-19 16:40Z: Cyclotron and Kanbus docs already have gated workflows. The Tactus docs workflow is PR 112 in the Tactus repo: GitHub refuses the merge until one approving review (Derek is the requested reviewer) and two more checks pass. Ryan's step: review Tactus PR 112. Biblicus and the Kanbus mkdocs site were still to be checked.
